spots.name: Ears Peak
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 689 m (2,261 ft).

spots.name: Teller
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 122 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L595793.
